name: Dobbm
summary: Austrian 36-card trick-taking game where one soloist faces three defenders with Hearts as permanent trumps, aiming for over 60 points.
rules_text: Played with 36 Tell cards, ranking Sau/Deuce >10 >King >Ober >Unter >9 >8 >7 >6 in all suits. Hearts are permanent trumps. Points: Sau 11, Ten 10, King 4, Ober 3, Unter 2, rest 0; 120 total. Four play, five with dealer sitting out; each gets 8 cards in 2x4, 4 cards form the Dobb talon. Forehand opens bidding, each one chance: pass, Dobbm or Solo. If all pass, redeal. Dobbm declarer takes the Dobb and discards 4 cards scoring for him; discarding a Sau requires also discarding a trump, two Sows require two trumps. Solo plays without exchange. Defender to left may double stake by calling Schwacher, others may double if first does not; declarer may say good or Retour, defenders may Retour again. Play clockwise, declarer leads first. Must follow suit (Farbzwang) if able, otherwise must trump (Trumpfzwang). Tricks won by highest trump or highest led suit. Defenders pool tricks. Score including Dobb/discards; >60 wins, 60-60 draw, all tricks is Matsch. Revoke penalized half game value. Payments scale with points over 60 and doubled by Solo, Schwacher and Retour.
